title: Deleting a Root Certificate for Zero Trust Browser in Internet & SaaS

blocks.text: You can delete almost all root certificates, excluding the default Zscaler Root Certificate. You can't delete the default because at least one root certificate is required per isolation profile. To learn more, see About Root Certificates for Zero Trust Browser in Internet & SaaS.

Additionally, if any other root certificates are associated with an isolation profile, you cannot delete them. You must first disable a certificate from the isolation profile before deleting it. To learn more, see Editing an Isolation Profile for Internet & SaaS.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Internet Access > Resources > Root Certificates.
Click the Delete icon for the certificate.
The Delete Root Certificates window appears.
